title: Self-Signed Certificates and ACME
objective: Choose certificate trust models and automate safe renewal.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Self-signed certificates encrypt traffic but are not publicly trusted. They suit controlled tests where the issuing certificate can be distributed deliberately.
ACME clients prove domain control to a certificate authority such as Let’s Encrypt. DNS, challenge reachability, key permissions, renewal schedules, and failure alerts all belong in the design.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Choose certificate trust models and automate safe renewal.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
certificate_policy:
  public_service: acme
  lab_service: self_signed
  private_key_mode: '0600'
  renewal: automated
  expiry_monitoring: enabled
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
